title: Configurational Taxonomy of Planetary Bodies: A Fuzzy-Set QCA of Orbital Hierarchy, Dynamical Dominance, Composition, and Evolution
domain: planetary science / comparative methods / set-theoretic analysis / taxonomy
summary: A falsification-first configurational taxonomy of 50 Solar-System bodies. Five blinded evidence batches now cover all cases and close the composition evidence-state layer at 50/50 without forcing certainty: surface-only or weakly constrained interiors remain explicit uncertainty/missingness. Overall evidence coverage is 188/300 and no QCA result has been inspected.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C022 froze the sample, evidence ontology and anti-circularity ladder before analysis. Evidence v0.6 closes composition evidence states across all 50 cases, expands source-conflict adjudication, and restores a fully resolvable current source registry. Surface spectra are explicitly separated from bulk-interior claims. No QCA calibration or solution inspection has occurred.

tables.status: case frame + physical + orbit + derived + evidence v0.6
